name: Pope Leo XIII
role: Head of the Catholic Church from 1878 to 1903
contribution: Head of the Catholic Church from 1878 until his death in 1903.
legacy: In his 1891 encyclical Rerum novarum, this person outlined the rights of workers to a fair wage, safe working conditions, and the formation of trade unions, while affirming the rights to property and free enterprise, opposing both atheistic communism and laissez-faire capitalism.

checks.lead: Pope Leo XIII (Italian: Leone XIII; born Gioacchino Vincenzo Raffaele Luigi Pecci; 2 March 1810 – 20 July 1903) was head of the Catholic Church from 1878 until his death in 1903. He had the fourth-longest reign and third-longest verified reign of any pope, behind those of St. Peter, Pius IX (his predecessor), and John Paul II.
